about: The crypt's north-south seam (the owner, 2026-11-20: a secret room may stand wall to wall with another room): the doorway a cracked wall opens between two rooms whose slabs stand against each other, 64 px from socket to socket (each room's 32 px of dark margin). Its floor a 64 px band of the rooms' own flagstones, so it reads as the room's floor going on, its sides a broken lip (crypt_edge) and an invisible wall (its void a wall). Never a bridge across the void (RoomBase.seam). tools/ground_shape.py draws crypt_seam_v_ground.tscn and its art from this.
